text:
maya: quick pulse — spotted a big jump in 'webinar leads' after launch posts on tuesday, want to sync before the weekly KPIs. anyone free to eyeball the numbers? :eyes:
analytics-bot: weekly digest: MQLs +18% WoW; Webinar signups 340 (+60%); Organic sessions +12%. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/kpis (last refresh 2026-03-16 09:02 UTC)
dez: dashboard shows 340 webinar leads but HubSpot pipeline only has 220 new webinar leads. big mismatch.
oliver: hmm, could be double-count from both the landing form and the RSVP widget? saw a similar issue last quarter.
ashley: we changed UTM tagging on the launch post — campaign param moved from `utm_campaign=launch-mar` to `utm_campaign=launch-mar_v2` on 03/16. that could fragment counts.
dez: @ashley can you confirm which channel we used in the email and socials? trying to map traffic sources.
ashley: email had `utm_source=launch-email`, socials were `utm_source=launch-social`, but the referral logic in the dashboard lumps some social clicks as organic if the redirect didn't preserve utm_source.
rik: also check attribution window — dashboard is last-touch 30d by default, our HubSpot view is 7d last-touch. that alone can inflate the dashboard numbers post-launch.
oliver: will run a quick SQL to compare distinct contacts by event vs dashboard metric. dropping snippet here:
```sql
SELECT
  event_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT hs_contact_id) AS distinct_webinar_leads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN utm_campaign LIKE 'launch-mar%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS launch_tagged
FROM hubspot_events
WHERE event = 'webinar_signup'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-18'
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date;
```
analytics-bot: quick calc: dedup'ed signups (by email) = 238; raw signups (form submissions) = 342. Difference explained by 1) duplicate submits, 2) RSVPs from widget not linked to HS contact, 3) utm fragmentation.
maya: ok actionable: (1) oliver, run deduped join to hubspot contact table and push list; (2) ashley, audit the redirect that drops utm params; (3) rik/dez, run parity check on attribution windows (7d vs 30d) and report delta in next 2 hours.
dez: for the parity check, i'll run compare metrics for last 14 days and post a csv. any preferences on primary metric? HubSpot uses `primary_assigned_lead` so i'd mirror that.
ashley: i'll revert the redirect for the social landing to preserve utm_source and add a short TTL redirect on the ticket widget so params persist. will update here when done.
rik: ran quick test — 7d window reduces webinar-attributed MQLs by ~35%. attaching the filter query i'll use and will schedule a consistent reporting window going forward.
maya: perfect. let's avoid changing attribution mid-report. for weekly KPI review, we'll present both 7d and 30d views and call out the tag fragmentation.
analytics-bot: automated note: scheduled dashboard refresh at 2026-03-16T11:00Z will include dedupe pipeline.
maya: thanks all — we'll reconvene in 30m if the parity numbers are ready. +1 if you saw this :thumbsup:
dez: +1
oliver: +1
ashley: on it
rik: on it
analytics-bot: logged tasks: #A-443 (dedupe pipeline), #A-444 (utm redirect audit).
